lessonTitle: Acts Chapter 22 — Paul Speaks to the Crowd

questions.questionText: Paul said, Brothers and fathers, listen now to my defense. In what language?
Paul said I am a Jew, born in Tarsus of Cilicia, but brought up in this city. I studied under whom?
Paul said he persecuted the followers of this Way to their death, arresting both men and women and throwing them into prison. He got letters from whom?
options: The high priest and all the Council

questions.questionText: About noon as I came near Damascus, what happened?
options: A bright light from heaven flashed around me

questions.questionText: I fell to the ground and heard a voice say, Saul! Saul! Why do you persecute me? Who spoke?
True or false: My companions saw the light, but they did not understand the voice.
options: True — and they also spoke to Jesus

questions.questionText: I asked, What shall I do, Lord? He said go to Damascus and there you will be told. After the brightness what happened to Paul?
A man named Ananias came to see me. He was a devout observer of the law and highly respected by all the Jews living there. Who is he?
Ananias said, Brother Saul, receive your sight! When did Paul see him?
Ananias said the God of our ancestors has chosen you to know his will and to see the Righteous One. What should Paul do?
options: Get up, be baptized and wash your sins away, calling on his name

questions.questionText: When I returned to Jerusalem and was praying at the temple, I fell into a trance and saw the Lord speaking. He said leave Jerusalem because they will not accept your testimony. Paul said they know he imprisoned believers. Where did the Lord send him?
options: To Caesar at once in this verse

questions.questionText: The crowd listened until he said that word. Then they shouted what?
options: Rid the earth of him! He’s not fit to live!

questions.questionText: As they were shouting and throwing off their cloaks and flinging dust into the air, the commander ordered Paul to be taken where?
options: Into the barracks to be flogged and interrogated

questions.questionText: As they stretched him out to flog him, Paul said to the centurion, Is it legal for you to flog a Roman citizen who hasn’t even been found guilty? The centurion told the commander what?
options: This man is a Roman citizen

questions.questionText: The commander said, I had to pay a lot of money for my citizenship. What did Paul say?
options: But I was born a citizen

questions.questionText: Those who were about to interrogate him withdrew immediately. The commander himself was what?
options: Alarmed because he had put Paul, a Roman citizen, in chains

questions.questionText: The commander released Paul and ordered the chief priests and all the members of the Sanhedrin to assemble. Then he brought Paul and had him stand before them. When?
Paul studied under Gamaliel in which city?
Paul was going to Damascus to bring believers as prisoners to where?
I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom you are persecuting. Who spoke from heaven?
Who led Paul by the hand into Damascus because he was blind?
True or false: Ananias was highly respected by all the Jews living there.
options: True — but he refused to come

questions.questionText: Ananias said you will be his witness to all people of what you have seen and heard. Then what should Paul do?
Paul was praying in the temple when he fell into a trance. Where?
The Lord said, Quick! Leave Jerusalem immediately, because the people here will not accept your testimony about me. Paul argued they know he approved of whose death?
The Lord said, Go; I will send you far away to the _____.
The people were shouting and throwing off their cloaks and flinging what into the air?
I told the commander this man is a Roman citizen. Who am I?
True or false: Paul was born a Roman citizen.
options: False — he was not a citizen
True — the commander was also born one

questions.questionText: Who wanted to find out exactly why Paul was being accused by the Jews?
I trained Paul thoroughly in the law of our ancestors. Who am I?
True or false: The crowd became very quiet when they heard Aramaic.
The bright light flashed around noon near which city?
Paul asked the voice, Who are you, Lord? The answer was?
options: I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom you are persecuting

questions.questionText: Those who were about to flog Paul withdrew because he was what?
The commander ordered the Sanhedrin to assemble and brought Paul to stand before them. Which group?
options: The chief priests and all the Sanhedrin

questions.questionText: True or false: Paul said he was as zealous for God as any of them are.
options: False — he said he never cared
True — but he never persecuted anyone

questions.questionText: The blood of your martyr Stephen was shed and I stood there giving my approval and guarding the clothes. Who am I?
Ananias said, Brother Saul, receive your _____.
After saying he was sent to the Gentiles, the crowd said he is not fit to what?
